name: Playlist Maker
description: Build playlists quickly with live genre/artist based recommendations, similar to Spotify or Apple Music.
overview: Adds a Playlist Maker page under Dashboard > Plugins with a fast search + drag-free playlist builder and a live 'more like this' recommendations panel driven by genre and artist matching.

versions.changelog:
## v1.0.4.0
- Fix (for real this time): every API call (Search/Genres/Artists/Recommendations) still
  failed with a 500 TypeLoadException/MissingMethodException on Jellyfin.Data.Entities.User
  even after v1.0.3.0. The actual cause was never a duplicate bundled assembly (the packaged
  plugin zip only ever contained this plugin's own DLL) - Jellyfin 10.11.x moved its host
  process from .NET 8 to .NET 9, so a plugin compiled for net8.0 was being loaded into a
  .NET 9 process, a genuine runtime ABI break. Now targets net9.0 and Jellyfin.Controller
  10.11.* to match the 10.11.x server line.

## v1.0.3.0
- Fix: every API call (Search/Genres/Artists/Recommendations) failed with a 500 error -
  TypeLoadException/MissingMethodException on Jellyfin.Data.Entities.User. `dotnet publish`
  was copying Jellyfin's own assemblies (Jellyfin.Data.dll, MediaBrowser.Controller.dll, etc.)
  into this plugin's own output folder. The server ended up with two different copies of those
  assemblies loaded at once - its own, and this plugin's bundled copy - and the CLR treats
  identically-named types from two different assembly instances as unrelated types. Excluded
  those packages' runtime assets from the build so only the host's own copies are ever used.

## v1.0.2.0
- Add a standalone app at /PlaylistMaker/App with its own login screen, reachable by any user
  (not just admins). Jellyfin's web client wraps its entire Dashboard section - where every
  plugin's config page lives, including this one - in an admin-only route guard, so the
  Dashboard page could never be reached by regular users no matter what else was fixed. This
  new page is served directly by the plugin, completely outside jellyfin-web's app shell, and
  authenticates with a normal Jellyfin username/password.

## v1.0.1.0
- Fix: the page rendered completely unstyled and never loaded any data. Jellyfin's page loader
  only keeps markup that lives inside the page's root `data-role="page"` div and discards
  everything else, so the separate playlistmaker.js/.css files were silently dropped on load.
  Everything is now a single self-contained page (inline styles + script), matching the pattern
  Jellyfin's own bundled plugins use.
- Fix: track fields from the API (Name, Id, Artists, etc.) are PascalCase; the UI was reading
  camelCase names and rendering nothing as a result.

## v1.0.0.0
- Initial release.
- "Playlist Maker" page under Dashboard > Plugins: search your library, pick genre/artist chips,
  and build a playlist.
- Live "Recommended For You" panel that scores your library by genre/artist overlap with the
  current draft.
- Cold-start fallback surfaces popular/recently added tracks when nothing has been picked yet.
